automaticChanges: clearer controls and wording without broader factual scope
bounded routing and content delivery improvements
holdConditions: broken or silently changed legacy report
confidenceRule: Confidence requires recorded evidence and completed applicable checks, never a model score or absence of feedback. An unaffected check may be not-applicable only with recorded impact analysis and evidence, never merely because tooling is unavailable.
minorIssueRule: An unresolved minor issue may proceed only when reversible, the affected function still works, no protected risk is present, and tracking, owner, next action, validation and a future review deadline are recorded.
feedbackRule: Scripted checks, customer feedback and silence are distinct. Synthetic checks cannot establish customer preference.
